source_caption:
In Succession S1 Episode 4, what starts as a playful bottle game quickly turns into a shocking display of Logan Roy’s unyielding nature. Even in front of his own grandson, Logan cannot accept defeat, showing just how deeply control and dominance run in the Roy family.

Watching the Roys is basically a masterclass in family dysfunction disguised as corporate strategy. Every meal, every game, every conversation feels like walking a tightrope over a pit of passive-aggressive landmines except the landmines are billion-dollar decisions and emotional trauma.

And honestly, if you’re thinking family game night is supposed to be fun, the Roys will prove you wrong in the most hilarious and terrifying way possible. Lose a game here and suddenly you’re questioning your life choices… and maybe even your will to inherit.

source_details.synopsis: Succession is an American satirical comedy-drama television series created by English screenwriter Jesse Armstrong that aired for four seasons on HBO from June 3, 2018, to May 28, 2023. The series centers on the Roy family, the owners of global media and entertainment conglomerate Waystar RoyCo, and their fight for control of the company amidst uncertainty about the health of the family's patriarch. Brian Cox portrays the family patriarch Logan Roy. His children are played by Alan Ruck as Connor, Jeremy Strong as Kendall, Kieran Culkin as Roman, and Sarah Snook as Shiv.
